topic: AI agents for accessibility, localization, documentation and SEO — a favourite heart button on a Flutter restaurant card announces itself to TalkBack as only "button", and how a hook finds unnamed controls, an agent confirms the real ones, and a concatenated status string becomes one translatable message.

stages.title: A heart on every card
stages.desc: An InkWell around a heart Icon. It passes every review.
stages.narration: Every restaurant card has a heart. It passes every code review.

stages.title: TalkBack on
stages.desc: Swipe to the heart. The phone says "button". On every card.
stages.narration: Turn on TalkBack. Swipe to the heart. It says, button.

stages.title: A script finds 15
stages.desc: Interactive widgets with no semanticLabel, tooltip or Semantics nearby.
stages.narration: A script finds fifteen candidates. Candidates, not fifteen bugs.

stages.title: The agent confirms
stages.desc: A Tooltip above or a Text child already names a control. The heart has neither.
stages.narration: The agent checks each one. Four are named. The heart is not.

stages.title: Name it
stages.desc: Semantics(label: "Add to favourites" or "Remove from favourites").
stages.narration: Wrap it in a semantics label that follows the state.

stages.title: Same story in strings
stages.desc: "Order ${id} → ${status}", built in English word order, inside a bloc.
stages.narration: Strings too. A sentence built from pieces cannot be translated.

stages.title: One message
stages.desc: orderStatusChanged(id, status), with a description for the translator.
stages.narration: The localization agent makes it one message, with a note for the translator.

stages.title: Ranked, and quoted
stages.desc: Titles measured in pixels. Question headings with two-sentence answers.
stages.narration: And the web pages get measured in pixels, and written to be quoted.

stages.title: Make it say what it does
stages.desc: A script finds candidates, an agent confirms them, a person listens.
stages.narration: It looks like a heart. Make it say so.

end.title: It looks like a heart. Make it say so.
end.sub: Accessibility and localization defects are silent for the team and loud for everyone else.

post.caption:
It looks like a heart. TalkBack says "button". ♿

A favourite button on every restaurant card in a Flutter app: an InkWell around a heart icon. It passes every code review, because to everyone reading the code it looks exactly right. With a screen reader on, it has no name.

Four agents for work that is invisible from inside the team:
♿ Accessibility: a script finds 15 candidates; the agent confirms which are real (a Tooltip above or a Text inside already names a control). The heart gets a Semantics label that follows its state.
🌐 Localization: "Order ${id} → ${status}" is built from English fragments. It becomes one ICU message with a note for the translator.
📄 Documentation: generate what goes stale; never let an agent invent the "why".
🔎 SEO / AEO: titles measured in pixels, answers written to be quoted.

Full article: blog.msdevbuild.com/blog/ai-agents-accessibility-localization-documentation-seo
